notes: Provide persistent inline progress, success and failure feedback for Library tools, Mover scans/retries/intake/recovery, disc-note saves, download actions and Manager/node update requests. Busy states prevent duplicate requests and controls recover after failures.
Contain keyboard focus in application popups, make the background inert while they are open, and restore focus when they close. Native confirmations keep their own keyboard behaviour.

Add keyboard arrow/Home/End navigation and accessible selected states to media-detail tabs; label fields and live status messages. Improve semantic button contrast across light, dark and system themes.
Give transfer progress meaningful per-title labels and distinguish unknown size from measured progress. Preserve warnings and complete destination verification before source cleanup.
